paired_differences.scope: Resamples 64 test windows conditional on 3 fixed training seeds; not uncertainty over new datasets, models, or the seed population. Finite 4-particle decoder, not implicit diffusion likelihood.
Resamples 64 test windows conditional on 3 fixed training seeds; not uncertainty over new datasets, models, or the seed population. Finite 4-particle decoder, not implicit diffusion likelihood.

verdict: This small direct pretrained conversion did not preserve baseline quality. It is not a successful large-model conversion and does not refute better adaptation methods or the paper.
limits: 14M model, 1.2M trainable with frozen lexical maps; not a large-model trial
Only 6,144 training token exposures per equal-data run and 32-token context
Only 1,024 test targets; pretrained exposure to WikiText unknown
No random-initialization ablation, distillation, MAUVE or teacher generative perplexity
Four-particle decoder approximation can overstate loss of the implicit model
Architecture not function-preserving: later pretrained blocks now receive lexical and noise codes rather than original hidden states
CPU timing and saved-tensor accounting are not GPU peak memory or end-to-end cost
